changeset-claim-re-read

## ⚠️ 1 pending changeset(s) describe a file this change touches

Their bodies publish **verbatim** into the CHANGELOG at the next release, so this is a request to **re-read them against your diff** — addressed here because you are the one seat that can answer it without re-deriving anything.

⛔ Nothing here blocks, and nothing here is a verdict on your change. This gate exits 0, is not a required context, and judges **name resolution, never meaning**: it asked whether a pending body names a file you touched. "Is this sentence still true?" is the one question it will not answer, and the one you are being asked to answer.

### `.changeset/6681-declared-lazy-marketplace-routes.md`

- names `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` → `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx` — edited by this change

  > Both marketplace chunks were held by CHUNK CO-TENANCY, not by any import of the page: rolldown had parked `components/SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx` (statically imported by the eager `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) in the first, and `console/marketplace/InstalledListWidget.tsx` (bare-imported by the package barrel for its SDUI registration) in the second. An `app-shell-eager-leaves` group in `apps/console/vite.config.ts` isolates those co-tenants so the three declared-lazy pages chunk by their own dynamic-only reachability. The console eager closure moves 3180.2 KB → 3171.5 KB gzipped (−8,888 bytes, 48 → 45 eager chunks) with the three per-chunk ceilings unmoved.

Read the **paragraph**, not the line: both false halves of the objectui#8617 claim sat in one paragraph, and correcting either alone would have left it asserting the same wrong thing.

If a claim did go false, **correct the body**. That is precedented and prose-only, frontmatter untouched; `check-changeset-overwrite.mjs` will report the correction as its own case 2 ("correcting a declaration on purpose … legitimate"), which is the intended shape — one gate asks for the read, the other records the write.

Not covered, stated so nobody reads this as more: a born-false claim that spells no line address at all (objectui#9495 coordinated one by ORDINAL — "a grep finds that member first" — and deciding that means reading what the sentence means), a claim spelled as a symbol or a package rather than a backticked file name, and a file named ambiguously.

Compared the checked-out tree with `0ffc423b1` (merge-base with origin/main): 4 file(s) changed outside `.changeset/`, read against 1788 pending declaration(s) that publish a body (2395 pending in total). · [run](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/36680445646)

| **Eager closure** (gzip, 330 chunks) | **3569.8 KB** | 3607.4 KB |
| Main entry chunk (gzip) | 149.5 KB | 350 KB |

| Status | **PASS** | — |

The **eager closure** is every chunk the entry reaches through static imports — what the browser fetches and parses before the app renders. The entry chunk on its own is a small fraction of it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `e591e1dfd8325eb48a5057c24192621fda4dbaee`
Local-runs: none

Inputs: card #11158 (its body and its four comments: triage `5901917705`, seat note `5902337716`, claim `5904947481`, os-dev-report `5905816901`), PR #11179 (body, the five-file list, the net diff against `main` at the head), the head's 42 check-runs read with `filter=latest`, and head/base file reads through the contents API. Binding direction: triage `5901917705`.

### ① Derived judgments

Each direction line of `5901917705`, judged against the diff:

1. **One helper — right.** `NavTree` computes `const labelText = navItemLabelText(node.label, locale)` once per node and uses it for the group heading (`{labelText}` beside the `Folder` icon), the entry text (`{labelText || surface?.name}`) and the `title` of an entry with no surface (`labelText || undefined`). `locale` is `useMetadataLocale()`, which `NavTree` already called at the base (the diff adds no hook), and each recursive `NavTree` for a group's children calls the hook itself. No second resolver: `navSurface.ts` imports the same `navItemLabelText` from `../metadata-admin/previews/navItemLabel.js`, and that helper is the spec's `resolveI18nLabel(label, locale) ?? ''`.
2. **`resolveSurface` resolves once — right.** `resolveSurface(node: NavNode, locale: string)` sets `const label = navItemLabelText(node.label, locale)` and carries it in `Surface.label`. All three callers pass the designer locale: `NavTree` (`resolveSurface(node, locale)`), the first-leaf auto-open inside `InterfacesPillar`'s app-load effect (`resolveSurface(n, locale)`), and `findSurfaceInTree(tree, initialSurface, locale)` behind `?surface=`. `findSurfaceInTree` still matches on `s.type === target.type && s.name === target.name`; `locale` only reaches the found leaf's label. **No `String()` of a label is left in `navSurface.ts`**: the five `String()` calls remaining at the head wrap `node.pageName`, `node.objectName`, `node.dashboardName`, `node.reportName` and `node.actionDef.actionName` — binding names, not labels. The base's `const label = String(node.label ?? '')` is gone.
3. **The type tells the truth — right; not Clause-②.** `NavNode.label?: I18nLabel` (a type import from `@objectstack/spec/ui`); `Surface.label` stays `string`, so every reader of a Surface still prints text. On the export question: `NavNode`, `Surface`, `resolveSurface` and `findSurfaceInTree` are module exports of `navSurface.ts` only. At the head `packages/app-shell/src/index.ts` exports from `studio-design/` exactly `StudioDesignSurface` plus `type StudioDesignSurfaceProps` (which is `{ aiSlot?: React.ReactNode }`), the four `studio-canvas-preview.js` values and its two prop types (neither names `Surface` or `NavNode`), and `BuilderLanding`; `package.json` `exports` is `.` and `./styles.css`. `InterfacesPillar` is a module export, not a root export. The widened type and the added `locale` parameter move no published contract, as the dev said.
4. **The load effect's dependency array — deliberate, consistent with the ruling; the consequence is real.** The deps stay `[client, packageId, publishNonce, draftNonce, metadataRefreshNonce]`; `locale` is read inside and not listed, with a comment saying why (a re-run rehydrates the nav edit buffer). Consequence: the `setCurrent` updater `cur ?? deepLinked ?? firstLeaf` stores a Surface whose `label` was resolved in that load's locale, and `current` is only replaced by a rail pick. After a designer-language switch the rail re-resolves on every render (it reads the hook), while the canvas caption `{current.label || current.name} · {translateMetadataType(current.type, locale)}` and the breadcrumb `{current.label || current.name}` keep the old locale's label text until another leaf is picked; the type half of the caption does switch, so the caption reads half-switched. The dependency array is not the cause: with `locale` listed, `cur ?? …` would keep the stored Surface just the same, so the staleness is a property of the ruling's "resolves once, the Surface carries text" design, not of this diff's dependency choice. Taken to ③ (b).
5. **Pins — right, and they cover the direction's three.** `StudioDesignSurface.interfacesRailLabelMap-11158.test.tsx` mounts the real `InterfacesPillar` over a mocked metadata client under `I18nProvider` language `en` and `zh` (`useMetadataLocale` maps `zh*` to `zh-CN`, else `en-US`; the spec resolver hits `zh-CN` exactly and `en` as the base of `en-US`, so the fixture's `{ en, 'zh-CN' }` maps resolve under both). Per language: (i) every rail row renders, map rows by their text, the plain-string `Landing` as authored (the control), the `url` row disabled and titled by its text, zero `console.error` containing "not valid as a React child", and no `[object Object]` in `document.body`; (ii) the first-leaf auto-open prints the map text in `if-canvas-caption` and `if-breadcrumb`; (iii) `?surface=page:reports` opens the nested map-labelled leaf, captioned in the designer locale and not as the first leaf. A fixture-parse case pins every item, maps included, as `NavigationItemSchema`-valid. `navSurface.test.ts` adds 7 cases: the `expectTypeOf` pin on `NavNode['label']` equal to `I18nLabel | undefined`, the map fixture parses, `resolveSurface` under `en-US` and `zh-CN` carries the text, the plain-string control in both locales, the unlabelled item carries `''`, and `findSurfaceInTree` finds the same `{type,name}` leaf in both locales; the 22 existing binding cases now pass `LOCALE` and are otherwise untouched.
6. **The six reverse-verification legs — consistent with the diff; judged by reading, nothing re-run.** Each mutation names an anchor present in the diff, and the observed counts fit the pin structure of 36 cases (29 in `navSurface.test.ts`: 18 `it` less the 3 templated ones, plus 4 variants × 3, plus the 2-row `it.each`; 7 in the pillar file). A1 and A3 (entry text, heading raw): 6 red = 3 pillar cases × 2 languages, with the card's React message. A2 (`String()` back in `resolveSurface`): 9 red = those 6 (the rows case also asserts no `[object Object]` in the body) plus the 3 unit map cases, with the control, the `''` case and the type pin green. A4 (`title` raw): 2 red = the rows case × 2, since React stringifies an object attribute rather than throwing. T1 (`label` back to `string`): TS2344 at the `expectTypeOf` pin plus TS2322 on the map fixtures. T2 (heading as `{node.label}`): TS2322 against `ReactNode`. Predicted direction matches observed in all six.
7. **Changeset — right.** `.changeset/interfaces-rail-label-map-11158.md` declares `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch`; the PR body carries `Clause-②: no`.

Other derived checks: the `title` attribute's `labelText || undefined` keeps the base's behaviour for an unlabelled entry (no attribute) and gives a map its text; the entry text keeps the objectui#7254 fallback to `surface.name` when the label resolves to `''`; the diff touches nothing outside the five listed files and carries no probe file.

Check-runs on the head (43 with `filter=latest`, all completed by 07:06Z; the last eight were still in progress when this review started and were waited on): 40 `success`, 3 `skipped` (`dependabot`, `Test (coverage)` and its shard job, skipped by design), 0 failures. The gate verdicts this diff can move are all green: Lint, Type Check, Test (shards 1 to 8 of 8) and the Test rollup, Test (dist pins), Build & E2E, Bundle Analysis, Changeset Bump Policy, Changeset Declaration, Changeset Claim Re-read, Changeset Fixed Group Check, Changeset Overwrite Report, Line Citation Gate, Control Byte Scan, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Inert vi.mock Specifier Check, Pre-Install Import Graph Check, Docs Route Eager Closure Check and Spec Main Shape Gate, with the doc and skill gates beside them.

### ② Semver level

`Clause-②: no` — confirmed against what the diff publishes. The only public-surface candidates (`NavNode.label` widened; `resolveSurface` and `findSurfaceInTree` gaining a required `locale`) live in `navSurface.ts`, which the package root never re-exports, and the one root-exported type from `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` does not reference them. What a consumer of `@object-ui/app-shell` sees is a behaviour fix in a Studio view: a rail that no longer crashes on spec-valid input and a caption that prints text. `'@object-ui/app-shell': patch` is the right level for the one released package whose source changed; the Changeset Bump Policy, Declaration, Claim Re-read and Fixed Group gates on the head agree.

### ③ Boundary flags

`open_questions`: none in `5905816901`.

Deviations (five):
- The directory test run passed the 10-minute foreground cap and finished in the background with exit 0. Process note, no bearing on the diff; CI's eight Test shards are the gate verdict here.
- One lock queue-timeout (exit 99) on the out-of-scope probe, retried and then measured. Process note; nothing to act on.
- The out-of-scope app-label finding was measured with an uncommitted probe, deleted afterwards. The PR's file list is the five files above; no probe file is in the diff. Answered.
- Attribution: the harness reminder asked for a model-named trailer; the one commit `e591e1dfd` carries `Co-authored-by: Claude` plus a `Claude-Session:` line, and the PR body ends with the session-URL footer, per objectui AGENTS.md (read from `pulls/11179/commits`). Answered; no change asked.
- The worktree was removed after the PR opened; the PR head is `e591e1dfd` and the branch is intact. Answered.

**(a) `InterfacesPillar`'s app heading through `String()` — real at the head, pre-existing, out of this card's scope; enumeration below.** At the head, `InterfacesPillar`'s app-load effect reads `String(published[0].label ?? published[0].name ?? packageId)` and, guarded only by `typeof body.label === 'string' || typeof body.name === 'string'`, `setAppLabel(String(body.label ?? body.name ?? label))`; a map label beside a string name passes the guard and stringifies. `appLabel` feeds `tFormat('engine.studio.if.navHeading', locale, { app: appLabel })` in the rail heading. Both statements are identical at the base `0ffc423b1` and sit outside every hunk of this diff: pre-existing and untouched. `AppSchema.label` is `I18nLabelSchema` in the spec, the same union as a nav item's, so the input is spec-valid. Out of scope by the claim's file surface (`NavTree`, `resolveSurface`, its three callers). Correctly named for the family's closure card rather than filed alone.

Enumeration for the closure card's nail: every remaining site in `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` (non-test sources at the head) that reads a spec-typed `I18nLabel` through `String()`. Classification by the spec's own label types: `AppSchema.label`, `PageSchema.label`, `DashboardSchema.label`, `ReportSchema.label` and `ActionSchema.label` are `I18nLabelSchema`; `ObjectSchema.label`, `FieldSchema.label`, `HookSchema.label`, `FlowSchema.label` and `PermissionSetSchema.label` are `z.string()`.

Sites that read an `I18nLabel` through `String()` — four, all the app's own label, all in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:
1. `StudioDesignSurface` component, `resolvePackageApp` callback: `String(a.label ?? a.name ?? '')` over `shellClient.list('app', { packageId })`, landing in `packageApp` (the topbar's app detection). At the head `packageApp` is read only as a boolean gate, so this string never reaches the screen: a latent mis-read.
2. `StudioDesignSurface` component, `resolvePackageApp` callback: `String(d.label ?? d.name)` over the first `listDrafts({ type: 'app' })` header; same sink as site 1.
